summary: MetaVia Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose an operational update on its Phase 1 clinical trial for DA-1726, an obesity treatment. The filing reports that enrolled patients completed dose titration and are receiving highest target doses (48 mg and 64 mg), with topline data expected in Q4 2026. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are mentioned. This is a routine business update, not a special situation. What to watch: the clinical data release in Q4 2026.
